complete_rule: For every required_role_id there must be exactly one current valid evidence record with a real task_path and delivery_path, matching task_version/input_revision/dependency_revision and the stage result requirement. For IMAGE-QA, all three effective bindings must also match required_asset_manifest_id+required_manifest_revision.
existence_rule: A role is not COMPLETE merely because its id appears in a completed list. The declared delivery_path must exist and its delivery fingerprint/commit must be recorded.
revision_rule: Changing required_role_ids, dependency_revision, required_asset_manifest_id, required_manifest_revision or barrier semantics requires barrier_revision+1 and a formal R01 task revision. Silent role removal or dependency change is forbidden.
carry_forward_rule: An older PASS can count only through a deterministic CARRY_FORWARD_BINDING for the current dependency revision. This is allowed only when every asset in that review dependency scope has identical asset_id+asset_revision+fingerprint. It never edits the original reviewer result.
authority: Only R01 may activate a new barrier revision or declare barrier completion after evidence validation.
